selected_geometry_inputs.nose_radius_selection: half nominal thickness; provisional, not measured
selected_geometry_inputs.placement: four equally spaced vertical plates per outlet, following current provisional aligned ruled transition; mounting not specified

scientific_limits: This is a geometry candidate for visual inspection, not a hardware validation or CFD result.
Do not infer uniform discharge or performance from the model.
The earlier fluid mesh retains zero-thickness dividers and does not include this candidate geometry or its nominal 6% mouth-area blockage.
A new mesh must exclude the closed solids from fluid and include local refinement; about 2 mm near the rounded 15 mm nose is a starting screening scale, not an acceptance tolerance.
